visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A fair-skinned hand with short, clean nails is seen in a close-up perspective, initially stroking and then firmly grasping a white, square-patterned textured quilt that lies on a bed covered with a floral-patterned sheet. The hand repeatedly and forcefully tugs at the edge of the quilt, which remains taut and immovable despite the physical effort. In the background, a white bedside table is partially visible, featuring a lit white candle in a glass jar and other small, out-of-focus household items under soft, warm lighting. (2) The camera pans and tilts upward in a continuous motion to reveal a wide shot of the bed. A young woman is lying horizontally across the mattress, her entire body from the neck down tightly and uniformly wrapped in the same white quilt, creating a cylindrical, cocoon-like shape. To her right, a golden-brown dog is curled up and sleeping peacefully on the bed's surface. The woman briefly opens her eyes and looks directly into the camera lens with a neutral, drowsy expression before closing them again as the shot holds steady on the scene.
